bank_level_rule.null_projector: SVD orthonormal basis of full meaningful span, then prior-null Gram-Schmidt

dose_calibration.selection_rule: lowest causal dose; otherwise lowest safe dose; no accuracy/G/C/D/ranking

family_split.assignment: deterministic and frozen after source qualification, before common outcomes

geometry.M1: activation-covariance-whitened with frozen regularization before common outcomes
geometry.M2: finite behavioral secant; full-vocabulary JS over frozen label-free probes

axes.negative_instruction: Answer from the first-pass result without an independent verification pass. End with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
axes.positive_instruction: Work carefully. After deriving a candidate answer, independently verify it with a second pass, correct any discrepancy, and end with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
axes.rationale: independent second-pass verification versus first-pass commitment

axes.negative_instruction: Solve holistically without writing an explicit step-by-step state trace. End with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
axes.positive_instruction: Solve by explicitly tracking program state step by step, including every variable update and control-flow transition. End with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
axes.rationale: state-transition bookkeeping versus holistic first-pass reasoning

axes.negative_instruction: Focus on the apparent final value without explicitly tracking runtime types, representations, mutation, or aliasing. End with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
axes.positive_instruction: Explicitly track runtime types, exact representations, mutation, aliasing, and container semantics wherever relevant. End with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
axes.rationale: runtime type/representation tracking versus value-only reasoning

axes.negative_instruction: Solve the problem directly as one undivided task without first naming subproblems. End with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
axes.positive_instruction: First decompose the problem into named subproblems, solve each subproblem, and then compose the result. End with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
axes.rationale: explicit subproblem decomposition versus undivided direct solving

axes.negative_instruction: Solve without formulating or checking a loop or state invariant. End with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
axes.positive_instruction: Identify the relevant loop or state invariant, use it while solving, and verify it at the end. End with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
axes.rationale: invariant-based consistency checking versus no explicit invariant

axes.negative_instruction: Commit the direct derivation without testing a counterexample or alternative case. End with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
axes.positive_instruction: After deriving the answer, test it against a nearby counterexample or alternative case and revise if needed. End with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.

source_axes.conceptual_distinctness_rule: No cosmetic paraphrase qualifies as a distinct family; rationale and held-out activation/behavioral separation are required.
